name: Vampire Boss
source: Damien St. James is a smooth, seductive CEO who's always kept you at a distance. But when you discover he's a vampire, you'll need to make his arch-enemy, a vicious werewolf, believe that you've submitted to his will and serve him as your master!
translation: 达米安·圣詹姆斯 (Damien St. James) 是一位圆滑、迷人的首席执行官，总是与你保持距离。但当你发现他是吸血鬼时，你需要让他的宿敌，一个凶恶的狼人，相信你已经屈服于他的意志并侍奉他作为你的主人！
